assumptions: 2026 reconstruction studies 1795 documents; it does not establish the exact 1592 vessel.
Published 35.27 m overall length includes a 9.21 m tail. The difference 26.06 m is only a derived scaling reference, not Lpp or Lwl.
Artistic visual mesh and fitted symmetric envelope are not the official reconstruction CAD.
Mass budget, CG and radii of gyration are declared plausible loading assumptions; exact historical mass distribution is unknown.
Model is watertight; openings, flooding, oars, sails, rudder forces and wind are excluded.
1:10 Froude scaling represents gravity-wave motions, not simultaneous full-scale Reynolds similarity.
Linear harmonic response about a fixed mean speed. This does not predict free-coasting deceleration, viscous resistance or startup; SPH is a separate initial-value problem.
Second-order incident shape plus linear scattered waves is a visualization approximation, not a full nonlinear solution.
The approximately 12.6 degree pitch amplitude at this large wave height exceeds a comfortable small-motion regime; use qualitatively, not as a quantitatively reliable large-wave prediction.
